rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the throat, including the front of the neck and the internal throat area.

example.english: My throat has been sore all day, and even swallowing saliva is difficult.

rows.note: Use this specifically when the English throat means the windpipe.

example.english: Years of smoking have inflamed my throat, so I cough all the time.

rows.note: Use this specifically when the English throat means the gullet or passage carrying food to the stomach.

example.english: A fish bone got stuck in my throat, and it hurts to swallow.
